messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Hello, this is Metro Commercial Bank security department. There is an unauthorized transfer attempt on your savings account.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Oh no, what should I do?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: We can block it right now. We have sent a one-time password to your registered number.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Read me the OTP so I can cancel the transaction immediately.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Wait, should I not call the branch first?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: There is no time! Within 5 minutes the money will be gone. Do not tell anyone, this is a confidential investigation.
